protocol.E2_scope: Gold nearest unique matches plus false-positive exclusion. Compare matched-inferred-IDs to isolate identity on the same retained observations.
protocol.E3_E4_scope: Identical perfect observations, inferred versus gold IDs. No RGB success claim.
protocol.E1_scope: Gold D4 orientation diagnostic, never automatic performance.
protocol.scoring: Frozen M3 queries, native physical scale, anchor-only translation, 0.5 mm.
protocol.bootstrap: 20000 draws, patient/backend balanced, descriptive development intervals.
protocol.signal_experiments: Separate conditional study, never inferred from geometry scores.
